description: The closed registry of payload formats a Grove recording DocumentReference may carry. Every content entry declares exactly one registry format in DocumentReference.content.format, and a receiver can parse any admitted payload from that code alone; an unregistered payload format is nonconformant. A format code names the payload's schema — the shape of the table or record it carries — never its encoding and never the platform that produced it. The encoding is carried by the entry's media type, and the producing platform by the carrying document's source type.

csv.structure: One header row naming every column in order, then one row per source sample in source order.
csv.rowTerminator: LF (0x0A) after every row, including the last.
csv.quoting: A field is enclosed in double quotes exactly when it contains a comma, a double quote, or a line break; embedded double quotes are doubled; all other fields are unquoted.
csv.numbers: Decimal numbers use the shortest representation that round-trips an IEEE-754 binary64 value; integral values may carry a trailing .0.
csv.timestamps: Seconds since the Unix epoch as a decimal number in the numbers form above; the column documentation states which columns are timestamps.

specification.structure: A single JSON array; each element is one complete FHIR R4 resource in FHIR JSON representation, in source sample order.
specification.resources: Every element conforms to the profile set the emitting adapter declares for its stream; the array carries resources of one stream and one batch only.
specification.emptyBatch: An empty batch emits no document rather than an empty array.

specification.structure: One complete provider-issued FHIR R4 resource in FHIR JSON representation, byte-preserved exactly as the source platform delivered it.
specification.fhirVersion: R4 only. A payload in another release is not admitted under this code: its media type would misdeclare the release to any receiver that reads only the media type. A release other than R4 needs its own registered format before it can be carried.
specification.provenance: The carrying document records the issuing source; Grove never asserts conformance over another issuer's resource.
specification.scope: One document carries exactly one clinical record's FHIR payload.

specification.file: One HL7 Clinical Document Architecture Release 2 document, byte-preserved exactly as the source platform delivered it. Grove never rewrites, reserializes, or asserts conformance over another issuer's document; the carrying document records the issuer.

specification.structure: The producer's exact native JSON serialization of one source batch, byte-preserved.
specification.schema: The emitting adapter documents the per-stream JSON schema; a stream without a documented schema cannot claim this format.
specification.scope: One document carries one stream and one batch.

specification.structure: The verbatim JSON payload returned by the provider API call that produced the batch, byte-preserved apart from transport framing.
specification.provenance: The emitting adapter documents the provider, API, and endpoint per stream; the payload is never rewritten, reordered, or reserialized.
specification.scope: One document carries one API response for one account and one source element batch.

primitives.varint: Unsigned LEB128: little-endian groups of 7 bits, high bit set on every byte except the last; signed integers are first truncated to their 64-bit two's-complement pattern, so negative values occupy ten bytes.
primitives.float64: IEEE-754 binary64 bit pattern, big-endian (network byte order), eight bytes.
primitives.string: Varint UTF-8 byte count, then the UTF-8 bytes.
primitives.array: Varint element count, then the elements in order.
primitives.set: Varint element count, then the elements; element order is not significant and receivers must not rely on it.
primitives.optional: One boolean presence byte; when true, the value follows.

specification.file: Varint record count, then that many PPG records.
